export_evidence: ImportKey page https://importkey.com/countries/india/jaya-hind-industries-ltd loaded as a paywalled shell: the only shipment-related text was 'Shipments available for JAYA HIND INDUSTRIES LTD, refreshed daily' and 'Loading...' — 0 concrete shipment rows visible (no date, no destination, no HS code, no B/L number). Volza (https://www.volza.com/p/jaya-hind-industries/), Eximpedia (https://www.eximpedia.app/companies/jaya-hind-industries-ltd) and Trademo (https://www.trademo.com/companies/jaya-hind-industries-ltd/) all returned HTTP 403 Forbidden; ImportGenius returned a JavaScript 'Client Challenge' wall. No export record with date/destination/HS/B-L could be read from any free source.
domestic_evidence: Company website https://www.jayahind.com/ states: 'Jaya Hind Industries is a fully vertically integrated aluminium die casting company with over 80 years of engineering and manufacturing expertise' and 'With over 45 HPDC machines which includes India's only 4400-ton Bühler machine to over 250+ CNC machining centers across India and Germany'. This is a self-declaration of manufacturing capacity only — no GST turnover figure, no GeM/CPPP tender, no contract and no annual-report revenue split was found in the sources actually read.
note: Registry/catalogue and company-site claims are out of scope as shipment proof, so neither export nor domestic supply is confirmed. Export status is 'unknown' rather than 'none_found' because every free shipment-data provider was blocked (403 / JS challenge / paywall) — the absence of visible rows is a tooling limitation, not evidence of no shipments. Domestic status is 'declared_only': the site asserts large-scale die-cast component supply to automotive OEMs, but no GST turnover band, tender award or contract record was retrieved. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in sources read; not invented). HS 840991 (parts for spark-ignition engines) is broadly consistent with the declared product range (cylinder heads, cylinder blocks, crankcases), but no customs line was seen to confirm the actual code — no HS correction is asserted here. Legal entity: site refers to 'Jaya Hind Industries Private Limited' (Abhay Firodia Group, MD Prasan Firodia), matching the claimed legal name; CIN/PAN not verified in this pass. No rejection grounds observed.
